question:
Which of the following is not computer hardware?

[RRB JE CBT-II 28-08-2019 (morning)]
options: Software
Floppy disk
CPU
Motherboard
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Software

Explanation:
Computer hardware refers to the physical components that we can touch and see, such as a floppy disk (a storage device), CPU (Central Processing Unit, the brain of the computer), and motherboard (the main circuit board that connects all components). On the other hand, software is a set of instructions and data that tells the hardware what to do. It is an intangible component, a program, not a physical object. Therefore, software is not hardware but a fundamental component of a computer system that makes the hardware functional.

Extra Facts:
A computer system has two main components: hardware and software. Hardware can be further classified into input devices (e.g., keyboard, mouse), output devices (e.g., monitor, printer), processing devices (CPU), and storage devices (e.g., hard disk, floppy disk). Software is primarily of two types: system software (e.g., operating system) that manages the hardware, and application software (e.g., word processor) that helps perform specific user tasks.

question:
The ........... controls communications for the entire computer system.

[Allahabad High Court (RO) 05/01/2022]
options: ALU
Semiconductor
Motherboard
Coprocessor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Motherboard

Explanation:
The motherboard controls communications for the entire computer system because it is the main circuit board that connects all hardware components. It provides the bus system for data transfer between the CPU, RAM, storage devices, and other peripherals. Components like the chipset and BIOS on the motherboard coordinate communication between various devices. The ALU is only responsible for arithmetic and logical operations, semiconductor is a material for electronic components, and a coprocessor assists the CPU in specific tasks.

Extra Facts:
The motherboard is also called the mainboard or system board and provides connectivity through various ports and slots like PCI, SATA, USB. Modern motherboards include integrated peripheral controllers that handle networking and audio functions. The BIOS/UEFI firmware manages hardware initialization and configuration, enabling efficient system communication.

question:
The concept of "stored-program architecture", which greatly influenced modern computing, was first articulated by which of the following pioneers?

[UPSSSC X-Ray Technician 15.12.2024]
options: Grace Hopper
John von Neumann
Steve Jobs
Bill Gates
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is John von Neumann

Explanation:
The concept of stored-program architecture was first articulated by John von Neumann in his 1945 report "First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC". In this architecture, both program instructions and data are stored in the same computer memory (RAM). This became known as the von Neumann Architecture and remains the fundamental design of most modern computers today. It simplified programming because programs could be changed without rewiring the hardware. It established a crucial separation between a computer's software and hardware, forming the basis for modern computing.

Extra Facts:
The main components of the von Neumann Architecture are: the Central Processing Unit (CPU), Memory, and Input/Output devices. A key limitation is the "von Neumann bottleneck", where the CPU can only either fetch an instruction or data from memory at one time, not both simultaneously. In contrast, the Harvard Architecture uses separate memories and buses for instructions and data, often used in embedded systems and microcontrollers. John von Neumann was also a mathematician and physicist who made significant contributions to game theory and quantum mechanics.

Extra Facts:
वॉन न्यूमैन आर्किटेक्चर के मुख्य घटक हैं: सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट (CPU), मेमोरी, और इनपुट/आउटपुट डिवाइस। इसकी एक सीमा "वॉन न्यूमैन बॉटलनेक" है, जहां CPU एक ही समय में या तो मेमोरी से निर्देश पढ़ सकता है या डेटा, दोनों नहीं। इसके विपरीत, हार्वर्ड आर्किटेक्चर में निर्देश और डेटा के लिए अलग-अलग मेमोरी और बस होती हैं, जो अक्सर एम्बेडेड सिस्टम और माइक्रोकंट्रोलर में उपयोग होती है। जॉन वॉन न्यूमैन एक गणितज्ञ और भौतिक विज्ञानी भी थे, जिन्होंने गेम थ्योरी और क्वांटम मैकेनिक्स में भी योगदान दिया।

question:
Which computer components are interconnected by a system bus?

[UPPCL TG-2 7/11/2023 (Shift-I)]
options: Motherboard and I/O
CPU and memory
CPU, I/O and RAM
CPU and HDD
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU, I/O and RAM

Explanation:
The system bus is a communication pathway that facilitates the exchange of data and control signals between the core components of a computer. It directly interconnects the CPU with the main memory (RAM) and I/O devices. The motherboard itself is the platform that houses these components, while the HDD is typically connected via specific interfaces (like SATA) rather than directly through the system bus. The system bus consists of three sub-buses: the Data Bus (for data transfer), the Address Bus (to specify memory locations), and the Control Bus (for managing control signals).

Extra Facts:
The system bus is closely related to the concept of the Northbridge in computer architecture, which acts as a bridge between the CPU, RAM, and high-speed graphics bus. In modern computers, this functionality is often integrated directly into the CPU. The bus's clock speed (measured in MHz) significantly influences the system's overall performance. A bus arbitration mechanism ensures that only one device can control the bus at a time, preventing data collisions and maintaining orderly communication between components.

question:
IC chips used in computers are made of

[MPPCS (J) 2018 Shift-I]
options: Silicon
Chromium
Lead
Silver
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Silicon

Explanation:
IC chips (Integrated Circuits) are made of Silicon because silicon is a semiconductor material. It neither conducts electricity like a good conductor nor insulates like an insulator, but its properties can be controlled. By adding dopants (impurities) to its crystal structure, it can be turned into P-type or N-type semiconductors, forming transistors, diodes, and other electronic components. It is the second most abundant element on Earth after oxygen, making it cheap and easily available. Due to its high temperature tolerance and reliability, it is the ideal material for manufacturing computer processors, memory chips, and other electronic devices.

Extra Facts:
The IC (Integrated Circuit) was invented in 1958 by Jack Kilby, for which he received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2000. IC chips follow Moore's Law, which states that the number of transistors on a chip doubles approximately every two years. Besides silicon, Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) is also used in some specialized high-frequency devices. Modern IC manufacturing uses photolithography techniques to create circuits at the nanometer level, continuously improving computer speed and capacity.

question:
Who is known as the 'father of computing'?

[Allahabad High Court (ARO)]
options: John Napier
Gottfried Leibniz
Edmund Gunter
Charles Babbage
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Charles Babbage

Explanation:
Charles Babbage is recognized as the 'father of computing' because he conceptualized the Analytical Engine in the 19th century, which was a mechanical general-purpose computer. This design laid the foundation for modern computers, incorporating features like an Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), basic flow control, and integrated memory. Although his engine was never completed during his lifetime, its architecture introduced the concept of programmability. Ada Lovelace wrote algorithms for it, earning her the title of the 'world's first programmer'. Babbage's contributions are fundamental to hardware architecture and computational theory.

Extra Facts:
Charles Babbage also developed the Difference Engine, a mechanical calculator for computing logarithmic tables. In computing history, Alan Turing is considered the 'father of artificial intelligence' and John von Neumann is regarded as the 'father of modern computer architecture'. Babbage's work inspired the stored-program computer concept, which forms the basis of all modern digital computers. His contributions are indirectly recognized in the development of programming languages and the foundations of operating systems.

question:
Which of the following is not a part of the motherboard?

[UPPCL Office Assistant III 24-10-2018 (Mor.)]

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is DVD Drive

Explanation:
The DVD Drive is not part of the motherboard; it is a peripheral device that connects to the motherboard via SATA or IDE cables. The motherboard is the computer's main circuit board containing directly mounted components like CPU, RAM, expansion slots, storage connectors, and other integrated circuits. Expansion card slots (PCI, PCIe), storage connectors (SATA, M.2), and memory slots (DIMM) are all integral components of the motherboard that directly connect various hardware.

Extra Facts:
The motherboard, also called the mainboard or system board, serves as the computer system's central nervous system. It contains BIOS/UEFI firmware that controls the boot process. Northbridge and Southbridge (or modern chipsets) are crucial motherboard components managing data flow. ATX, Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX are standard motherboard form factors. The motherboard's VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) ensures stable power supply to the CPU.

question:
Which of the following semiconductor devices can act as a simple switch?

[NVS PGT 19.09.2019 (Shift-I)]
options: Diode
Transistor
Capacitor
Resistor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Transistor

Explanation:
A transistor is a semiconductor device that can function as both a switch and an amplifier. When no voltage is applied to the base terminal of a transistor, it remains in the OFF state and no current flows (acting as an open switch). When sufficient voltage is applied to the base, it switches to the ON state and allows current to flow (acting as a closed switch). This fundamental switching capability makes transistors essential components in digital circuits, memory chips, and microprocessors. While diodes allow current flow in one direction only, capacitors and resistors cannot perform switching functions.

Extra Facts:
The transistor was invented in 1947 at Bell Labs by John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, and William Shockley. It's typically made from semiconductor materials like silicon or germanium. The two main types of transistors are BJT (Bipolar Junction Transistor) and FET (Field Effect Transistor). Transistors form the basis of Moore's Law, which describes the continuous increase in computing power. Modern CPUs contain billions of transistors that function as switches to create logic gates and perform computational operations.

question:
Program counter (PC) register is an integral part of :

[(RRB SSE (Shift-II), 03.09.2015)]
options: Hard Disk
RAM
Cache memory
CPU
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU

Explanation:
The Program Counter (PC) register is an integral part of the CPU (Central Processing Unit). It is a special-purpose register that stores the memory address of the next instruction to be executed. When a program runs, the PC is continuously updated so the CPU knows where to fetch the next instruction from. It plays a crucial role in the fetch stage of the instruction cycle (fetch-decode-execute). Hard disks, RAM, and cache memory are all storage devices, whereas the PC register is located directly inside the CPU and is managed by the processor's control unit.

Extra Facts:
The CPU contains several types of registers that assist in processing. The Accumulator register stores results of arithmetic and logical operations. The Instruction Register holds the instruction currently being executed. The Memory Address Register (MAR) and Memory Buffer Register (MBR) are used for memory access. All these registers work together to efficiently complete the instruction cycle, enhancing the computer's speed and performance.

प्रोग्राम काउंटर (PC) रजिस्टर सीपीयू (Central Processing Unit) का एक अनिवार्य घटक है। यह एक स्पेशल पर्पज रजिस्टर है जो अगले निष्पादित होने वाले निर्देश के मेमोरी एड्रेस को स्टोर करता है। जब कोई प्रोग्राम चलता है, तो PC लगातार अपडेट होता रहता है ताकि CPU को पता चल सके कि अगला निर्देश कहाँ से फ़ेच करना है। यह निर्देश चक्र (fetch-decode-execute cycle) के फ़ेच चरण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। हार्ड डिस्क, RAM और कैश मेमोरी सभी स्टोरेज डिवाइस हैं, जबकि PC रजिस्टर सीधे CPU के अंदर स्थित होता है और प्रोसेसर के कंट्रोल यूनिट द्वारा प्रबंधित किया जाता है।

Extra Facts:

The Control Unit is a core component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) that manages and coordinates all computer operations. The Control Unit manages the fetch, decode, and execute cycle, ensuring that the right data reaches the correct device at the proper time. It functions as the 'traffic controller' within the computer, without which hardware components cannot work together efficiently. This unit is essential for interpreting instructions and maintaining synchronization between different parts of the CPU.

Extra Facts:
The CPU consists of three main components: Control Unit (CU), Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), and Registers. The Control Unit regulates the machine cycle while the ALU performs mathematical and logical operations. In the Von Neumann Architecture, the Control Unit plays a vital role in implementing the stored program concept. In modern microprocessors, the Control Unit is highly optimized and can process multiple instructions simultaneously through pipelining techniques, significantly improving computational efficiency and performance in complex computing tasks.

question:
Which of the following storage units is an integral part of the CPU (CPU)?

[UPPCL TG-II 27-03-2021 (Shift-II), (SSC CGL (TIER-1) 09-09-2016, 4.15 pm)]
options: CD (CD)
Read Only Memory (ROM)
Register (Register)
Random Access Memory (RAM)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Register

Explanation:
The Register is an integral part of the CPU because it is located directly inside the CPU and is used for immediate data processing during instruction execution. Registers are small, high-speed storage locations that hold the data and instructions currently being processed by the CPU. They operate at the same speed as the CPU, enabling efficient execution. In contrast, other options like CD, ROM, and RAM are either primary memory or secondary storage devices located outside the CPU and are not integral components of it. Registers play a critical role in optimizing processor performance.

Extra Facts:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is the brain of the computer, responsible for executing all instructions. It consists of three main components: the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) handles mathematical and logical operations, the CU (Control Unit) directs the operation of the processor, and Registers provide temporary storage for fast access. Cache memory acts as a high-speed buffer between the CPU and main memory. While RAM and ROM are types of primary memory, they are separate from the CPU and are not part of its internal structure.

question:
Which memory can be directly accessed by the computer's CPU?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 25-11-2022 Shift-II]
options: Magnetic tape
Hard disc
Memory card
Cache memory
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cache memory

Explanation:
The memory that can be directly accessed by the CPU is cache memory. It is the high-speed memory located closest to the CPU and is based on semiconductor technology. Cache memory is part of the primary memory and acts as a buffer between the CPU and main memory (RAM). It has the lowest access time (1-10 nanoseconds), while hard disk, magnetic tape, and memory card are secondary storage devices that cannot be directly accessed by the CPU. These are all mechanical devices with access speeds thousands of times slower than cache memory.

Extra Facts:
In computer memory hierarchy, cache memory sits at the top. It is made of SRAM (Static RAM) which is faster but more expensive than DRAM. Cache memory comes in three levels: L1 (internal cache), L2, and L3. L1 cache is the fastest and is embedded directly in the CPU core. The Memory Management Unit (MMU) handles data transfer between cache and main memory. The hit rate of cache memory significantly affects system performance.

question:
Which among the following carries control information between the CPU and other devices within the computer?

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control Bus

The Control Bus carries control information between the CPU and other devices within the computer system. Computer buses are of three types: Data Bus (data transfer), Address Bus (memory location), and Control Bus (control signals). The Control Bus is bidirectional and maintains synchronization with the system clock. It controls memory access, I/O operations, and interrupt handling. In modern computer architecture, the bus system significantly impacts system performance.

question:

options: Arithmetic unit
Logic unit
Control unit

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control unit

Explanation:
The Control Unit (CU) is the component of the CPU that controls and coordinates all operations of the computer. It fetches instructions from memory, decodes them, and then manages the execution of those instructions by sending necessary signals to other units. While the Arithmetic Unit performs mathematical calculations and the Logic Unit handles logical operations, the actual management and coordination of instruction execution is performed by the Control Unit. Thus, it acts as the 'brain' or manager of the computer's Central Processing Unit (CPU).

Extra Facts:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is often called the brain of the computer and consists of three main components: Control Unit (CU), Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), and Registers. The ALU and CU together form the processor core. The Control Unit decides which data is sent where and when. It controls the computer's fetch-decode-execute cycle, which is the fundamental basis for running any program.

question:
The basic computation unit of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) is known as?

[UPSSSC ETO 19.01.2025]
options: Core
Processor
Random Access Memory (RAM)
Disc
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Core

Explanation:
The basic computation unit of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) is known as the Core. A Core is an independent processing unit capable of fetching, decoding, and executing instructions. Modern CPUs can have multiple cores, such as dual-core or quad-core, which enable the computer to handle multiple tasks simultaneously (multitasking). It is the core that performs arithmetic and logical calculations (via the ALU) and provides control signals (via the CU). The other options are incorrect: Processor is another name for the CPU itself, RAM is a temporary memory, and Disc is a permanent storage device.

Extra Facts:
The CPU is the brain of the computer and consists of three main components: the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) performs calculations, the Control Unit (CU) coordinates instructions, and Registers hold temporary data. Multi-core processors have revolutionized computing capabilities by enabling parallel processing. CPU speed is measured in Hertz (GHz). Cache memory is an ultra-fast memory inside the CPU that stores frequently used data to enhance performance.

question:
When one device attempts to send a message to another device, the data is sent over the internet in the form of manageable packets and each packet is assigned a ........... that will connect it to its endpoint.

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 24-11-2022 Shift-II]
options: network number
computer number
port number
router number
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is port number

Explanation:
Internet data transmission is based on packet switching technology. When one device sends a message to another device, data is divided into small packets. Each packet is assigned a specific port number to reach its destination. A port number is a 16-bit numerical identifier that represents a specific application or service. It operates at the Transport Layer of the TCP/IP model and ensures data reaches the correct application. For example, HTTP uses port 80 and HTTPS uses port 443.

Extra Facts:
In networking, port numbers can range from 0 to 65535. They are divided into three categories: Well-known ports (0-1023), Registered ports (1024-49151), and Dynamic/Private ports (49152-65535). While an IP address identifies a device, a port number identifies the specific application running on that device. This enables multiplexing, where multiple applications can operate simultaneously on the same device.

नेटवर्किंग में पोर्ट नंबर 0 से 65535 तक हो सकते हैं। इन्हें तीन श्रेणियों में बाँटा गया है: वेल-नोन पोर्ट्स (0-1023), रजिस्टर्ड पोर्ट्स (1024-49151), और डायनामिक/प्राइवेट पोर्ट्स (49152-65535)। IP एड्रेस डिवाइस की पहचान करता है, जबकि पोर्ट नंबर उस डिवाइस पर चल रहे specific application की पहचान करता है। यह मल्टीप्लेक्सिंग को संभव बनाता है, जहाँ एक ही डिवाइस पर कई एप्लिकेशन्स simultaneously काम कर सकते हैं।

question:

[UPPCL Office Assistant Account 28-8-2018]

Information

solution:

This process involves stages like data collection, validation, classification, calculation, summarization, and storage. By processing incomplete or unstructured data, computer systems convert it into decision-useful information. Database management systems, programming algorithms, and networking protocols all contribute to this transformation process. Information is the final product that provides valuable insights to businesses, researchers, and individuals for informed decision-making.

Extra Facts:
Data processing is the core function of computer systems following the input-process-output cycle. Operating systems manage various processing tasks, while programming languages like Python and SQL provide tools for data manipulation. Big data analytics and artificial intelligence represent advanced forms of modern data processing. Data quality, processing speed, and storage capacity are critical factors determining any computing system's performance. Database normalization and data mining techniques further enhance the efficiency of data processing operations.

question:
Which of the following statements is FALSE about hardware?

[UPPCL TG-2 17/11/2023 (Shift-I)]
options: Hardware consists of input devices, output devices, memory, etc.
Hardware design is based on architectural decisions to make it work over a range of environmental conditions and time.
Hardware works only on binary codes 1's and 0's.
Hardware will vary as per the computer and its built-in functions and programming language.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Option 4 - Hardware will vary as per the computer and its built-in functions and programming language.

Explanation:
This statement is FALSE because hardware design and functionality do not depend on programming language. Hardware comprises physical components like CPU, RAM, motherboard, input/output devices, etc., which operate on binary code (0s and 1s). Programming languages are part of software and are independent of hardware. The same hardware can run software written in different programming languages. Hardware design is based on architectural decisions, not programming language.

Extra Facts:
The main difference between hardware and software is that hardware is physical while software is logical. Without hardware, software is useless. Firmware acts as an interface between hardware and software. In computer architecture, the Von Neumann architecture is fundamental, consisting of input, output, memory, and CPU. Hardware functionality is controlled by machine language, which is the basis of all programming languages.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है विकल्प 4 - हार्डवेयर, कंप्यूटर और उसके बिल्टइन फंक्शनों और प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा के अनुसार अलग-अलग होंगे।

Explanation:
यह कथन गलत है क्योंकि हार्डवेयर का डिज़ाइन और कार्यप्रणाली प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा पर निर्भर नहीं करती। हार्डवेयर भौतिक उपकरणों जैसे CPU, RAM, मदरबोर्ड, इनपुट/आउटपुट डिवाइस आदि से मिलकर बनता है, जो बाइनरी कोड (0 और 1) पर काम करते हैं। प्रोग्रामिंग भाषाएँ सॉफ्टवेयर का हिस्सा हैं, जो हार्डवेयर से स्वतंत्र होती हैं। एक ही हार्डवेयर विभिन्न प्रोग्रामिंग भाषाओं में लिखे सॉफ्टवेयर चला सकता है। हार्डवेयर डिज़ाइन आर्किटेक्चरल निर्णयों पर आधारित होता है, न कि प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा पर।

Extra Facts:
हार्डवेयर और सॉफ्टवेयर में मुख्य अंतर यह है कि हार्डवेयर भौतिक होता है जबकि सॉफ्टवेयर तार्किक। हार्डवेयर के बिना सॉफ्टवेयर बेकार है। फर्मवेयर हार्डवेयर और सॉफ्टवेयर के बीच का इंटरफेस है। कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर में वॉन न्यूमैन आर्किटेक्चर मौलिक है, जिसमें इनपुट, आउटपुट, मेमोरी, और CPU शामिल हैं। हार्डवेयर की कार्यक्षमता मशीनी भाषा द्वारा नियंत्रित होती है, जो सभी प्रोग्रामिंग भाषाओं का आधार है।
